channel.title: Play by Ear Gamecast
channel.description: Original tabletop games designed for podcast audio. Play by Ear Gamecast is currently a public experimental laboratory exploring recorded voices, asymmetric stereo information, changing chapter images, puzzles, sound art, and unusual podcast-player mechanics. The episodes are prototypes and tests, not yet finished games. Find the project and contribute at https://github.com/udeudeude/Play-by-Ear-GameCast.

item.title: Link and Timestamp Diagnostics
item.itunes:author: Play by Ear
item.description:
Extra iOS 18 diagnostic episode: test several timestamp spellings in the notes below. Use the native chapter menu as the known-good control. An opening raw RSS page is a failure, not a successful seek.

Open this episode page

Tap each candidate below. SUCCESS = Apple Podcasts seeks in this episode. FAILURE = the raw RSS feed or a browser opens.

  • A at 00:00:16 (HH:MM:SS)
  • B at 00:32 (MM:SS)
  • C at 0:48 (M:SS)
  • D at 01:04 (MM:SS)
  • E at 00:01:20 (HH:MM:SS)

Control: use the player chapter menu to open Test A through Test E. Those are embedded ID3 chapters.
